dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the teeth-test cap-stripping robust to non-identifier cap values (e.g. AST-based removal or a value pattern that spans dotted/subscript/call expressions) so it cannot silently under-strip a future call.
evidence: Live sites use bare-identifier values so it works now: `_base.py:172` `maxResults=page_size`, `_issues.py:262` `maxResults=max_results`

If a value were `self.page_size`, the regex would match `, maxResults=self` leaving `.page_size` and the `maxResults` keyword would still be present in the parsed AST, so `_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default` would not flag it — the teeth test could pass with an un-stripped source.
dropped.finding: The teeth test's cap-stripping regex `,\s*max_?[Rr]esults=[A-Za-z_0-9]+` only matches cap values that are bare identifiers/numbers; a future call whose cap value is a dotted, subscripted, or call expression (e.g. `maxResults=self.page_size`) would not be fully stripped, leaving the `maxResults=` keyword intact so the AST predicate still treats it as capped — silently weakening the teeth test.
